problem: Developers using several coding agents have no single fast place to control them, especially from a phone. T3 Code is an open-source interface that runs agents on your machine.

stack.frontend: Web app, desktop app and iOS and Android apps (frameworks not stated)
stack.backend: TypeScript monorepo with a local server, built with the Effect library, plus a small Rust resource monitor
stack.ai: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Grok Build, Kiro, Pi and any ACP agent; MCP for outside agents
stack.deploy: Desktop installers (brew, winget, deb), a t3 CLI via npx or install script, and mobile apps

whatsNew: One server holds every thread, so you can start at your desk and approve the next step from your phone, and switch agents mid-thread. It drives your existing agent logins instead of reselling tokens.
